name: watercolour
description: Wet pigment on damp paper: pale even washes that stop at a hard edge where they dried, and granulation in the hollows where the paper's tooth held the colour.

prompt.default: a watercolour painting: transparent pigment pooled on damp paper, pale even washes that fade rather than end, a hard dried edge where each wash stopped, granulation settling into the hollows of the tooth, the white of the paper doing the light
prompt.flux: a watercolour painting on cold-pressed paper, transparent washes laid wet-in-wet, colour pooling and blooming at the edges, hard dried rims where a wash stopped, granulation in the tooth, unpainted paper left as the brightest light
prompt.sdxl: watercolor painting, transparent washes, wet edges, paper texture, granulation, delicate, unpainted white paper
